# Firewall actions are written ACCEPT/DROP, not the English verb.
ACCEPT_EXCEPT
# "a reinstall", "a rebuild" -- nouns here.
A_INSTALL
# "does root-level writes": a noun after "does", not a second inflection.
DOES_X_HAS
# Mis-guesses the article before a code span it cannot pronounce.
EN_A_VS_AN
# Deliberate parallel lists ("No X. No Y. No Z.").
ENGLISH_WORD_REPEAT_BEGINNING_RULE
# Repeated cells in comparison tables ("included | included").
ENGLISH_WORD_REPEAT_RULE
# Technical compounds this repo writes hyphenated: inter-node, inter-VLAN.
EN_COMPOUNDS_INTER_NODE
# "key id", "commit id", "client id" -- the spelling every API here uses.
ID_CASING
# alice/bob are AdGuard instance names, not people.
LOWERCASE_NAMES
# Dots inside names: jiahui.love, A1.Flex, unlimited-code.works.
LC_AFTER_PERIOD
# Paths: /etc/boot.d and friends.
NON_STANDARD_WORD
# .phd is a TLD in this estate, not a degree.
PH_D
# "the apps environment" is the environment named apps.
POSSESSIVE_APOSTROPHE
# "the deploy PR", "the deploy workflow" -- attributive, not a verb.
PREPOSITION_VERB
# Product names carry dots: A1.Flex, E2.1.Micro.
SENTENCE_WHITESPACE
# Bold lead-ins ("**Attack.** storage.md ...") and list continuations.
UPPERCASE_SENTENCE_START
# "the next deploy's diff" -- possessive of a noun.
VERB_APOSTROPHE_S
# Workload names take singular verbs: "hath is", "two serve".
AGREEMENT_SENT_START
CD_NN
PCT_SINGULAR_NOUN_PLURAL_VERB_AGREEMENT
SINGULAR_VERB_AFTER_THESE_OR_THOSE
# Empty leading cells in comparison tables.
WHITESPACE_RULE
# "the *how*" is the emphasis, not a typo for "how".
THE_HOW
